analysis_title: Meta 2022 CIB alan adı göstergelerinin yapısal analizi

method.unit: Distinct canonical domain string; not an operation or a content item.
method.canonicalization: Strip surrounding whitespace and lowercase; group on full domain string.
method.target_country: Exact country component of source comment: <label>-targeting CIB domain. Never inferred from DNS suffix or hosting.
method.last_dns_label: Literal text after the last dot. This is the root DNS/TLD label, not effective public suffix or registrable-domain boundary.
method.first_dns_label: Literal text before the first dot. Exact equality only; no fuzzy matching, publisher identity coding, or operator attribution.
method.source_csv_line_end: Physical CSV line number at end of record, including header.
method.time: ds is the source record date. It is not registration time, first activity, or publication date of a linked story.

interpretation_limits: The last DNS label does not measure registration price, hosting location, or targeted country. No suffix is classified as cheap.
Exact first-label reuse is a lexical pattern; it does not independently establish a common operator, campaign, publisher identity, content imitation, or intent.
Country and suffix shares describe this published selection. They are not estimates of all Russian operations or public-opinion effects.
All350 source records and all311 distinct domains have ds=2022-09-27; no activity timeline can be derived from ds.
Examples containing intermediate labels, such as bild.eu.com and theguardian.co.com, have last DNS label com. No Public Suffix List join was performed.
